anya: Heads-up — saw a 2x tail-latency regression on MoE routes after last week's kernel swap. All2All stalls at high concurrency, looks like queuing/backpressure, not just NCCL bandwidth.

kai: Can you paste the perf run? batch sizes, tp/pp? also which kernel change was rolled? @jun FYI

anya: repro command: `python -m rdinfer.bench --model moe-24g --tp 2 --pp 1 --batcher=dynamic --concurrency=48`
anya: before-kernel (stable) median p99 ~ 28ms, after-kernel median p99 ~ 58ms. throughput similar but latency tail doubled.

jun: thanks. sharing a quick trace from `ncu --target-processes all` — attaching flame output (perf-bot will link)

perf-bot: uploaded flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/perf/1834567890/moe-all2all-flame.svg :white_check_mark:

luis: looking at the flame, there's a tight hotspot inside our `expert_shuffle` loop where `scatter_gather` spends ~45% of GPU time. That lines up with queued kernel launches in the host-side loop.

marie: could be queuing due to KV-cache lookups blocking routing threads. Did batching heuristic change? dynamic batcher started delaying tokens to aggregate larger batches last week.

kai: I rolled the kernel set that swapped to the new fused all2all primitive (`all2all_fused_v2`). It reduced memory copies but changed stream ordering. Maybe we lost comm/compute overlap.

jun: quick snippet from the profile showing stream timers:
```
stream0 (compute): 0.8ms compute, then wait 2.1ms
stream1 (comm): all2all 1.9ms
stream0 resumes: 0.4ms
```
jun: looks like compute finishes then waits for comm — minimal overlap.

anya: so hypothesis: fused primitive is synchronous on the default stream or sets an event the compute stream waits for, preventing overlap. That would increase p99 under high concurrency when many experts trigger all2all.

luis: suggestion: try running with `export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_CLEANUP=1` and force the fused all2all onto a separate stream with `cudaEvent` decoupling to allow overlap. Also test fallback to `all2all_v1` kernel to confirm regression.

marie: I'll run an A/B test: route 10% of traffic to `all2all_v1` and 90% to `all2all_fused_v2` on dedicated infra, capture p50/p95/p99 and queue depth. ETA 2 hrs.

ops-bot: deploy start: rollout-6723 -> eng-runtime-dedicated-prod (manifest: moe-routing/rollout-6723) :rocket:

anya: thanks. if A/B confirms, we either patch the fused kernel to not block default stream or revert. Also need unit test that asserts comm/compute overlap under synthetic expert traffic.

kai: +1 on unit test. I'll add a microbench in `eng-runtime/tests/perf/test_moe_overlap.py` that asserts >= 30% overlap for our baseline config.

jun: if anyone needs the raw nvprof traces I uploaded them to `s3://perf-archives/1834567890/` — includes before/after and the per-stream timings.

luis: assigned follow-ups: marie (A/B runs), kai (test + kernel config tweak), jun (trace analysis), anya (postmortem draft). I'll open a short incident ticket.

perf-bot: ticket created: PERF-4387 — "MoE all2all p99 regression after all2all_fused_v2" — https://issues.redwood/release/PERF-4387

anya: cool, thanks everyone. please drop quick notes in the ticket with your findings so we can decide revert vs patch. :thumbsup:
